# xmatters_devices (Data Source)

Returns all devices in your xMatters instance that match the provided criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
// No filter is applied here, returning all devices
data "xmatters_devices" "get_device_list" {}

// Filters applied to limit returned devices
data "xmatters_devices" "get_device_list_with_filters" {
  filters = {
    device_status = "ACTIVE"
    device_type   = ["EMAIL"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes) Optional search parameters to filter the list of devices returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) List of available xMatters devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Optional:

- `device_names` (List of String) A list of device names. Returns a list of devices with the specified names.
- `device_status` (String) Returns all devices with the specified status. Available options are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE.
- `device_type` (List of String) Returns all devices with the specified type. Available options: ANDROID_PUSH, APPLE_PUSH, EMAIL, FAX, GENERIC, TEXT_PAGER, TEXT_PHONE, VOICE, VOICE_IVR.


<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Country code of the fax device.
- `default_device` (Boolean) If 'true', the device can receive notifications when the user has no other active devices.
- `delay` (Number) The number of minutes to wait for a response on this device before contacting the next device.
- `device_type` (String) The type of device. Available options are: EMAIL, TEXT_PAGER, TEXT_PHONE, VOICE, VOICE_IVR
- `email_address` (String) The email address of the device.
- `external_key` (String) Unique identifier of a resource in an external system.
- `externally_owned` (Boolean) Whether the device is managed by an external system.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters device.
- `name` (String) The name of the device. Device names are configured uniquely for each company.
- `owner` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the user that owns the device.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number associated with the device.
- `pin` (String) The PIN code of the pager. Required when the 'device_Type' is TEXT_PAGER.
- `priority_threshold` (String) The minimum priority of an alert for it to be delivered to this device. Available options are: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH.
- `sequence` (Number) The order in which devices are contacted, where 1 represents the first device.
- `status` (String) Status of the device in xMatters. Available options are: ACTIVE, INACTIVE. Default is ACTIVE.
- `target_name` (String) Device ID in xMatters consisting of owner’s target name, followed by the | (pipe) character, followed by the device name. For example, ‘mmcbride|Work Phone’.
- `test_status` (String) A code indicating whether the device has been tested or if testing is in progress. Available options are: TESTED, UNTESTED, PENDING, INVALID.
- `timeframes` (Attributes Set) A list of timeframes when xMatters may contact this device. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices--timeframes))
- `two_way_device` (Boolean) Required when the 'device_Type' is TEXT_PAGER. If 'true', the pager is able to send and receive messages. If 'false', the pager is only able to receive messages.

<a id="nestedatt--devices--timeframes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices.timeframes`

Read-Only:

- `days` (Set of String) List of the days of the week this timeframe is active.
- `duration_in_minutes` (Number) The length of the timeframe in minutes.
- `exclude_holidays` (Boolean) If ‘true’, the timeframe is excluded from site holidays; i.e., the device is not active on holidays.
- `name` (String) The name of the timeframe.
- `start_time` (String) The time of day that the timeframe begins.
